subject: Pilot follow-up: TCO assumptions, runbook, and tech kickoff slots
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lara Torres <lara.torres@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot follow-up: TCO assumptions, runbook, and tech kickoff slots

Hi Samir + Lara,

Quick follow-up after our call earlier this week. I summarized the TCO assumptions and added a short runbook outline for how we'll instrument and monitor caching during the pilot. Please find the attached TCO workbook and a pilot SOW draft.

TL;DR on cost assumptions (see workbook for line items):
- Baseline: 120M tokens/month, $0.030 per 1k tokens -> ~$3,600/mo token cost.
- Expected pilot savings: batching (10-15%), KV/prefix caching (25-30% token reduction with ~50% hit rate), quantized model (~30% compute savings).
- Conservative blended savings: ~45% -> projected pilot token spend ~$1,980/mo.

Runbook outline (short):
1) Instrumentation: Redwood Console will emit per-route metrics: total_tokens, tokens_saved_by_cache, cache_hit_rate, avg_request_tokens, per_token_cost_effective.
2) Sampling: we'll capture a 1% sample of raw requests + sanitized inputs to validate cache-hit assumptions and quality drift.
3) Alerts: daily regressions on cache-hit rate <30% or quality drop >2% trigger an ops call.
4) Ownership: Redwood will provide daily dashboards and a weekly summary; Acme owns labeling/accuracy checks for sampled outputs.

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm pilot budget guardrail (<$12k/mo) and preferred billing (PO vs SOW).
- Tech kick-off: Dev proposes 30-min slots today 11:00am PT or tomorrow 10:00am PT. Dev, can you confirm availability and attach a more detailed runbook?
- We'll share the DocuSign link for the pilot SOW once procurement confirms the route.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-tco-estimate.xlsx (TCO workbook), pilot-sow-draft.pdf (SOW)
